mainEntity.name: How long does it really take to create a digital product with AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can shorten drafting and planning time, but a realistic timeline depends on the product’s complexity, your source material, review process, and sales setup. A simple checklist or guide may be prepared faster than a polished course with videos, worksheets, email follow-up, checkout, and delivery. Context: Run My AI Biz treats research, creation, funnel preparation, and launch as connected stages rather than one automatic action. Key factors: scope, number of modules, media production, platform setup, revisions, and audience testing. Practical guidance: divide the project into research, outline, production, quality review, offer setup, and launch preparation, then set a completion standard for each stage. Use AI to create first drafts and task lists, not to promise an exact launch date. Run My AI Biz can help you structure a manageable workflow and identify delayed steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: There is no dependable single timeline. A small guide or template pack generally requires less work than a course with videos, worksheets, checkout, delivery, and email follow-up. Break the project into research, production, review, setup, and launch tasks so delays are visible.
